title: He was sent back to Kerala at age 4 for school. He just won a global award named after a US President.

sources.text: ANI via The Print - Sunny Varkey honoured with 2026 Eisenhower Global Transformation Award
Billionaires.Africa - Indian billionaire Sunny Varkey wins Eisenhower Global Award

caption:
He was sent back to Kerala at age 4 for school. He just won a global award named after a US President.

Born in Ranni, Kerala, Varkey's family moved to Dubai when he was very young, but he was sent back to Kerala around age 4 for schooling at a Catholic boarding school, returning to Dubai around 1970.

Varkey founded GEMS Education, now the largest private K-12 school operator globally and the Varkey Foundation, which created the Global Teacher Prize - the world's largest teaching award.

Varkey's path - sent home to Kerala for his own schooling, now funding recognition for teachers worldwide - is a reminder that investment in education compounds far beyond where it starts.
